key.name: monitoring-enabled
key.description: Whether the background process for theme monitoring is enabled.

key.name: schedule-mode
key.description: Switch the light/dark style at sunrise and sunset (sun), at light-time and dark-time (custom), or never (off). Runs in the background monitor.

key.name: light-time
key.description: Minutes after midnight when the custom schedule switches to the light style.

key.name: dark-time
key.description: Minutes after midnight when the custom schedule switches to the dark style.

key.name: last-coordinates
key.description: Latitude and longitude from GeoClue, used for sunrise and sunset. Out of range values mean none is known, and the system time zone gives the location.
